title: Citrus Freekeh
subtitle: with spinach, pomelo and fresh za'atar
description: Smoky freekeh cooked in orange juice with caramelised onion, folded through spinach and topped with pomelo segments and fresh za'atar leaves. Skip the yoghurt stone cheese to keep it vegan.

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat, add the finely chopped onions and cook for 5 to 6 minutes until translucent, then 3 to 4 more minutes until lightly golden. Add the spices and stir for 1 minute.
Add the well-rinsed freekeh and stir for about 2 minutes until coated in oil. Add the orange juice, water, salt and pepper and bring to the boil.
Cover and cook on low heat for about 20 minutes. Remove from the heat, then stir in the lemon zest and the finely chopped spinach.

Transfer to a serving plate and top with a mixture of pomelo segments, fresh za'atar leaves, olive oil, salt and pepper. Grate over some yoghurt stone cheese or Georgian cheese if you like, and serve.
